description: This file contains interface definitions for various Orleans grains used in the test suite, including methods for retrieving grain keys, labels, runtime information, and observer notification mechanisms, as well as one-way messaging capabilities.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Retrieves the grain's unique key (long, Guid).

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Obtains the label associated with the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Obtains the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to the grain itself.

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Tests the request context by returning a tuple of strings.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_Array
methods.description: Returns multiple grain interfaces as an array.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_List
methods.description: Returns multiple grain interfaces as a list.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer within the grain.

methods.name: DoLongAction
methods.description: Performs a long-running action with a specified timeout and message.

methods.name: GetKey (IGuidTestGrain)
methods.description: Retrieves the GUID key of the Guid grain.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Returns the address of the silo hosting the grain.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: One-way method to notify an observer.

methods.name: NotifyValueTask
methods.description: One-way method returning a ValueTask to notify an observer.

methods.name: ThrowsOneWay
methods.description: One-way method that throws an exception.

methods.name: ThrowsOneWayValueTask
methods.description: One-way method returning a ValueTask that throws an exception.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrain
methods.description: Notifies another grain with an observer.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrainValueTask
methods.description: Notifies another grain with an observer using ValueTask.

methods.name: GetOtherGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to another grain.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrain
methods.description: Sends a notification to another grain.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Retrieves a count value.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Gets the primary silo address for a grain.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Gets the activation address for a given grain.

methods.name: SignalSelfViaOther
methods.description: Signals itself via another grain.

methods.name: SendSignalTo
methods.description: Sends a signal to another grain (OneWay).

methods.name: WaitForSignal
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a signal, returning the number of signals and the signaller ID.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal with an identifier.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Notify method for ICanBeOneWayGrain.

methods.name: NotifyValueTask
methods.description: Notify with ValueTask for ICanBeOneWayGrain.

methods.name: Throws
methods.description: Throws an exception.

methods.name: ThrowsValueTask
methods.description: Throws an exception in a ValueTask.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Retrieves a count value.
